$comment: Prose for the generated API reference (src/docs/openapi.mjs). Shapes, types, limits, auth and rate limits come from openapi.json (npm run docs:openapi); this file only titles, explains, groups and hides. Keys are "METHOD /path" exactly as in openapi.json. docs:check validates it.

hide.$comment: Endpoints only markdrop.in's own pages, emails or apps call: sign-in redirects, email links, Google Docs export, the VS Code extension's sync protocol, the docs site's own endpoints, the MCP transport (documented under AI and MCP) and the health check.

examples.title: Release notes
examples.content:
# Release notes

Published from the API.
examples.name: Acme

params.slug: The document's address: the part after `markdrop.in/`.
params.workspace_id: The workspace's id, from the address of its settings page (`markdrop.in/settings/workspaces/<workspace-id>`) or from [List workspaces](/api/workspaces/list-workspaces).
params.upload_id: The `upload_id` that [Start a file upload](/api/files/start-a-file-upload) returned.
params.x-edit-secret: The document's edit secret (`sk_…`), for a document published without an account. See [Edit key](/documents/edit-key).
params.x-read-password: The password of a password-protected document.

fields.title: Shown on the page and in link previews.
fields.custom_slug: Your own address: `markdrop.in/<custom_slug>`. Letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Taken or reserved addresses answer `409`.
fields.expires_in: When the document is deleted. `custom` needs `custom_expires_at`.
fields.custom_expires_at: The deletion time, when `expires_in` is `custom`. Must be in the future.
fields.read_password: Readers must enter this password before they see the content.
fields.access_level: Who can open it: `link` (anyone with the link), `private` (only you and the people you share it with) or `workspace` (members of its workspace).
fields.workspace: File it in this workspace: the workspace's id.
fields.folder: An existing folder of `workspace`: its id or its path, like `guides/setup`.
fields.encrypted: Set by clients that encrypt in the browser: `content` and `title` are already ciphertext. The server never sees the key.
fields.DocumentResponse.workspace_url: The address on its workspace's own domain, when it has a live one.
fields.DocumentResponse.kind: `markdown` for a document, `artifact` for a file.
fields.DocumentResponse.can: What you may do with it: `edit`, `replace`, `settings`, `access`, `rename`, `delete`, `share`, `move`, `unshare`.
fields.DocumentCreateResponse.edit_secret: Returned once. Send it as `X-Edit-Secret` to change or delete a document published without a token.
fields.UploadCreateRequest.file_name: The file's name, with its extension.
fields.UploadCreateRequest.size_bytes: The file's exact size in bytes.
fields.UploadCreateRequest.sha256: The SHA-256 of the whole file, in hex. The server checks it before the file goes live.
fields.UploadCreateRequest.target_slug: Replace the file behind this existing address instead of publishing a new one. The link, access and views stay.
fields.UploadCompleteRequest.parts: Each part's number and the `ETag` storage returned when you uploaded it.
fields.UploadUrlsRequest.part_numbers: The parts that need a fresh URL. Leave it out for every part not yet uploaded.
fields.LevelUpdate.level: `link` (anyone with the link), `private` (only the people you share it with) or `workspace` (members of its workspace).
fields.GrantCreate.email: The person's email address. They don't need an account yet.
fields.GrantCreate.role: `viewer` can open it; `editor` can also change it.
fields.GrantCreate.message: A note included in the email.
fields.AccessRequestDecision.decision: `view` or `edit` approves with that role; `decline` refuses.
fields.DomainCreate.kind: `app` serves documents and files; `cdn` serves files only.
fields.WorkspaceDeleteRequest.confirm_name: The workspace's name, typed back, to confirm.
fields.FolderCreate.parent_id: Create it inside this folder. Leave it out for the top level.
fields.TokenCreateRequest.name: A name to recognise it by, like the script or device that uses it.
fields.ApiTokenCreateResponse.token: The token. Shown only in this response: store it now.
fields.PreferencesUpdate.analytics_digest: `weekly` sends the weekly analytics email; `off` stops it.
fields.SlugChangeRequest.new_slug: The new address. The old one keeps working as a redirect for people who can read the document.
fields.ItemsAdd.folder_id: File them in this folder. Leave it out for the top level.
fields.ItemsAdd.access: Also change who can open them. Left out, their access doesn't change.
fields.ItemsMove.folder_id: The destination folder, or `null` for the top level.
fields.FolderShare.level: `link`: anyone with the folder link; `workspace`: members only. Each visitor still sees only the documents they could already open.

POST /api/v1/documents.title: Publish a document
POST /api/v1/documents.description: Creates a Markdown document and returns its link. Works without an account: send a token to own it. Keep the `edit_secret` from a call without a token: it is the only way to change or delete that document later.

example.title: Release notes
example.content:
# Release notes

Published from the API.

responses.201: Created. Returns the document with its `slug`, `url` and `edit_secret`.
responses.409: The custom address is taken, or reserved.

GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}.title: Read a document
GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}.description:
Returns a document's content and details, if you may read it. For a private or workspace document, send a token; for a password-protected one, send the password in `X-Read-Password`.

A document whose address changed answers at its old address too, but only to someone who can read it: `200` with `"moved": true` and the current `slug`.

responses.401: It needs a token, or the right password.
responses.404: No such document, or you can't open it.

PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}.title: Update a document
PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}.description: Replaces a document's content, and optionally its title, password and expiry. Send a token as the owner or an editor, or the document's edit secret in `X-Edit-Secret`.

example.title: Release notes
example.content:
# Release notes

Updated from the API.

DELETE /api/v1/documents/{slug}.title: Delete a document
DELETE /api/v1/documents/{slug}.description: Deletes a document for good. Send a token as the owner, or the document's edit secret in `X-Edit-Secret`.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/edit-secre.title: Rotate the edit secret
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/edit-secre.description: Replaces a document's edit secret, for when the old one leaked. The old secret stops working at once; the new one is in the response, once. Owner only.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/claim.title: Claim a document
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/claim.description: Adds a document you published without an account to your account. Send its edit secret in `X-Edit-Secret`.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/copy.title: Copy a document
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/copy.description: Makes a copy of a document you can read, owned by you, with a new address, no password and no expiry. The copy is private unless the original is open to anyone with the link.

PATCH /api/v1/documents/{slug}/slug.title: Change the address
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{slug}/slug.description: Gives a document a new address. Its old address keeps working for people who can read it.

responses.409: That address is taken, or reserved.

PATCH /api/v1/documents/{slug}/settings.title: Set password and expiry
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{slug}/settings.description: Changes a document's password or expiry without sending its content. Every field is optional: leave one out to keep it. `"read_password": ""` removes the password. Send a token as the owner, or the edit secret.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/report.title: Report a document
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/report.description: Flags a document for abuse. Always answers `202`, whether or not the address exists.

GET /api/v1/me/documents.title: List your documents
GET /api/v1/me/documents.description: The documents and files you own, a page at a time, with counts of each kind.

paramNotes.q: Only titles or addresses containing this text.
paramNotes.per_page: Same as `limit`, up to 50; wins when both are sent.

GET /api/v1/og/{slug}.png.title: Get the preview image
GET /api/v1/og/{slug}.png.description: The 1200×630 image link previews show for a document, as PNG.

paramNotes.host: Draw the card for this address (a workspace's own domain) instead of markdrop.in.

POST /api/v1/files/uploads.title: Start a file upload
POST /api/v1/files/uploads.description:
Starts publishing a file of any size: send its name, size and SHA-256, and get back presigned URLs to `PUT` each part to. Then [finish the upload](/api/files/finish-a-file-upload). With `target_slug`, the file replaces the one behind an existing link instead, keeping the link, its access and its views.

The CLI does all of this, with resume, in one command.

responses.409: The address you asked for is taken, or reserved.
responses.413: The file is over the size limit for its type.

POST /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}/u.title: Get fresh part URLs
POST /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}/u.description: New presigned URLs for parts of an upload in progress, for when the first ones expired before you used them.

GET /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}.title: Check an upload
GET /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}.description: Where an upload stands: how many parts arrived and, once finished, whether the check passed (`state` is `done`, with `result`) or failed (`failed`, with `error`).

POST /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}/c.title: Finish a file upload
POST /api/v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}/c.description: Publishes the file once every part is uploaded. The server checks the SHA-256 first. `200` returns the link. `202` (`{"state": "verifying"}`) means the check is still running: [check the upload](/api/files/check-an-upload) until `state` is `done`. Calling it again on a finished upload returns the same result.

responses.202: Still checking the file. Poll the upload's status.

GET /api/v1/files/{slug}.title: Get file details
GET /api/v1/files/{slug}.description: A published file's size, type, current version, SHA-256 and, for video and audio, its duration and dimensions.

GET /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions.title: List file versions
GET /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions.description: Every version of a file you own or can edit. Replacing a file keeps the previous version.

POST /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions/{vers.title: Restore a file version
POST /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions/{vers.description: Makes an earlier version current again, at the same link. Versions start at 1.

DELETE /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions/{ve.title: Delete a file version
DELETE /api/v1/files/{slug}/versions/{ve.description: Deletes one earlier version for good and frees its space. Only the file's owner can do this, and never for the current version.

responses.403: You can edit the file but don't own it.
responses.409: That's the current version. Restore another one first, or delete the file.

POST /api/v1/artifacts/paste.title: Publish an HTML page
POST /api/v1/artifacts/paste.description: Publishes HTML you send in the request as a page that renders. Up to 10 MB; anything larger goes through [Start a file upload](/api/files/start-a-file-upload).

POST /api/v1/artifacts/upload-url.title: Get a single upload URL
POST /api/v1/artifacts/upload-url.description: The one-request upload markdrop.in uses for smaller files: returns a presigned URL to `PUT` the whole file to, then [publish it](/api/files/publish-an-uploaded-file). For anything large, or to resume, use [Start a file upload](/api/files/start-a-file-upload).

responses.413: The file is over the size limit for its type.

POST /api/v1/artifacts.title: Publish an uploaded file
POST /api/v1/artifacts.description: Publishes a file uploaded with [Get a single upload URL](/api/files/get-a-single-upload-url), after checking its real size and type.

PATCH /api/v1/artifacts/{slug}.title: Update a file's settings
PATCH /api/v1/artifacts/{slug}.description: Changes a file's title, password or expiry. Every field is optional. The owner may change all of them; editors may change the title.

PUT /api/v1/artifacts/{slug}/file.title: Replace a file
PUT /api/v1/artifacts/{slug}/file.description: Swaps the file behind a link for one uploaded with [Get a single upload URL](/api/files/get-a-single-upload-url), keeping the link and its settings. The previous file is kept as a version.

GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access.title: Get sharing settings
GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access.description: Who can open a document and the people it is shared with. People with a role on the document can call it; the list of people is for the owner and editors.

PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/leve.title: Set who can open it
PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/leve.description: Sets a document's access level. Narrowing it takes effect at once, for every address the document has.

POST /api/v1/documents/access/level.title: Set access for several documents
POST /api/v1/documents/access/level.description: Sets the access level of many documents you own at once. Each one is checked on its own: the response has a result per address.

PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/resh.title: Let editors share
PUT /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/resh.description: Whether editors may share the document with more people.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/peo.title: Share with a person
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access/peo.description: Gives one person access by email, and optionally emails them. If the email fails, the access stays: the response says whether it was sent.

POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access-req.title: Request access
POST /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access-req.description: Asks the owner of a document you can't open for access. The owner can approve or decline it.

example.message: Could I see the Q3 numbers?

GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access-requ.title: Check your request
GET /api/v1/documents/{slug}/access-requ.description: Whether your request for access to a document is pending, approved or declined.

GET /api/v1/me/access-requests.title: List requests for you
GET /api/v1/me/access-requests.description: Requests for access to documents you own.

GET /api/v1/access-requests/{request_id}.title: Get an access request
GET /api/v1/access-requests/{request_id}.description: One request for access to a document you own.

POST /api/v1/access-requests/{request_id.title: Answer an access request
POST /api/v1/access-requests/{request_id.description: Approves a request as a viewer or editor, or declines it.

GET /api/v1/workspaces.title: List workspaces
GET /api/v1/workspaces.description: The workspaces you belong to, with your role in each and their live domains.

POST /api/v1/workspaces.title: Create a workspace
POST /api/v1/workspaces.description: Creates a workspace with you as its owner.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Get a workspace
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: A workspace's name, branding, settings and your role in it.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Update a workspace
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Changes a workspace's name, branding or settings. Every field is optional.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Delete a workspace
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Deletes a workspace, its folders and its domains. Documents filed in it are not deleted: they go back to their owners. Send the workspace's name to confirm.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/me.title: List members
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/me.description: Everyone in a workspace, with their roles.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/me.title: Change a member's role
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/me.description: Makes a member an admin, a member or a viewer.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/in.title: List invitations
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/in.description: Invitations that haven't been answered yet.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.title: Invite someone
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.description: Emails someone an invitation to join the workspace.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Revoke an invitation
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Withdraws an invitation that hasn't been answered yet.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/b.title: Upload a logo or favicon
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/b.description: Uploads an image and returns its URL. It isn't used until you save that URL in the workspace's branding with [Update a workspace](/api/workspaces/update-a-workspace).

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/t.title: Transfer ownership
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/t.description: Makes another member the owner. You become an admin. Documents, sharing and domains don't change. Owner only.

GET /api/v1/invites/{token}.title: Preview an invitation
GET /api/v1/invites/{token}.description: What an invitation link is for: the workspace, the role and whether it is still open. Answers `200` for invitations already accepted or withdrawn too, saying so.

paramNotes.token: The token from the invitation link.

POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/accept.title: Accept an invitation
POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/accept.description: Joins the workspace with the role the invitation offers, as the account the token belongs to.

paramNotes.token: The token from the invitation link.

POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/decline.title: Decline an invitation
POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/decline.description: Turns an invitation down. No token needed: the invitation link is enough.

paramNotes.token: The token from the invitation link.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/f.title: Create a folder
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/f.description: Creates a folder at the top level, or inside another folder with `parent_id`.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.title: Update a folder
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.description: Renames a folder, or moves it with `parent_id` and `reparent: true`.

PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/.title: Rename or move a folder
PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/.description: Renames a folder, changes its address, moves it (`parent_id`; `null` is the top level) or sets the access new documents in it start with. Admins and the owner. Every document below it moves to its new address.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Delete a folder
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Deletes a folder. The documents in it aren't deleted: `unfiled_documents` says how many are no longer in a folder.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/tr.title: Get the folder tree
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/tr.description: The workspace's folders as a tree, with their paths.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/it.title: List workspace items
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/it.description: The documents and folders in a workspace that you can see.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/pr.title: Preview as someone else
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/pr.description: What another person would see in a folder, and what is hidden from them and why. Members can preview; previewing a named person (`as` set to an email) is for admins.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.title: File documents
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.description: Files documents you own into the workspace. Their access stays the same unless you send `access`.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.title: Move documents
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.description: Moves documents to another folder. Every document is checked first: if you can't move one, none move.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.title: Take documents out
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/i.description: Takes documents out of the workspace. They go back to their owners. A document with `workspace` access becomes `private`.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Move a document
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Moves one document to a folder (`folder_id`), or to the top level (`null`).

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.title: Share a folder
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.description: Creates a link to a folder. Each visitor sees only the documents they could already open: sharing a folder never changes any document's access. `hidden` lists what the link's audience can't see.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.title: Get a folder's link
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fo.description: The folder's share, or `404` when it isn't shared.

GET /api/v1/folders/shared/{share_id}.title: Open a shared folder
GET /api/v1/folders/shared/{share_id}.description: What a shared folder link shows: the folder, its subfolders and the documents in it that you can open. A folder shared with `workspace` access needs a member's token.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: List workspace documents
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: The documents filed in a workspace.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Add a document
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Files one of your documents in the workspace, by its id.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: Count workspace documents
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: How many documents a workspace has in each folder.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Remove a document
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Takes a document out of the workspace. It isn't deleted: it goes back to its owner unchanged.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: File in a folder
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: Puts a workspace document in a folder, or at the top level with `null`.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: List domains
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: A workspace's custom domains and where each one stands.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Add a domain
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Adds a domain to a workspace and returns the DNS records to create at your DNS provider.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Verify a domain
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Checks the domain's DNS records now, instead of waiting for the next automatic check.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Turn on a domain
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Starts serving a verified domain, with HTTPS.

responses.501: Domains can't be turned on automatically here. Finish the step by hand.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.title: Take a domain offline
POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/d.description: Stops serving a domain without losing its verification, so you can turn it back on later.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: Detect the DNS provider
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: Which DNS provider the domain uses, so setup instructions can name the right screens. Makes a live DNS lookup.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.title: Set the primary domain
PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/do.description: Chooses the domain the workspace's links and previews use. Admins and the owner.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.title: Remove a domain
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}.description: Removes a domain from the workspace. Links on it stop working; the documents keep their markdrop.in addresses.

GET /api/v1/me/analytics.title: Analytics for everything
GET /api/v1/me/analytics.description: Totals across every document and file you own.

GET /api/v1/me/analytics/live.title: Who is reading now
GET /api/v1/me/analytics/live.description: People reading or watching your documents right now.

GET /api/v1/me/analytics.csv.title: Export all analytics
GET /api/v1/me/analytics.csv.description: Your analytics across every document, as CSV.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Document view totals
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: View counts, unique readers, read depth and top referrers for a document. Owner only: anyone else who can read it gets `403`.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Document overview
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: The headline numbers for one document or file you own.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Video and audio retention
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: How many people are still watching or listening through a video or audio file.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Video frame
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: A frame of your video at `t` seconds, as JPEG. `404` when the file isn't a video.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Reading depth
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: How far readers get through a Markdown document, section by section.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: PDF pages reached
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: How many readers reach each page of a PDF.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Audience
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: Who a document's readers are: new or returning, their devices and countries.

GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.title: Numbers by version
GET /api/v1/me/documents/{slug}/analytic.description: A file's numbers split by the version people saw.

PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences.title: Set the weekly email
PATCH /api/v1/me/preferences.description: Turns the weekly analytics email on or off.

GET /api/v1/auth/me.title: Get your account
GET /api/v1/auth/me.description: The account a token belongs to: id, email, name and sign-in methods. A quick way to check a token works.

GET /api/v1/me/tokens.title: List API tokens
GET /api/v1/me/tokens.description: Your API tokens: name, first characters, when each was created and last used. Never the tokens themselves.

POST /api/v1/me/tokens.title: Create an API token
POST /api/v1/me/tokens.description: Creates an API token (`mdk_…`). It is shown only in this response.

DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{token_id}.title: Revoke an API token
DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{token_id}.description: Revokes a token at once. Requests with it get `401` from then on.

GET /api/v1/me/contacts.title: Suggest people
GET /api/v1/me/contacts.description: Up to 50 people you can share with: people you shared documents with before, and members of your workspaces. Never a search of every account.

paramNotes.q: Only people whose email or name contains this text.

GET /api/v1/me/shared.title: Shared with you
GET /api/v1/me/shared.description: Documents other people shared with you, a page at a time.

GET /api/v1/search/quick.title: Quick search
GET /api/v1/search/quick.description: Finds files, folders and workspaces you can open by title, address or file name. Never searches content.
